body.statement:
For every admissible pair with \(2\leq n\leq5\), the exact sharp coordinate-degree frontier is
\[
\begin{array}{c|c}
 n & D_k(n)\\ \hline
 2 & D_0(2)=1,\\
 3 & D_k(3)=1\quad(0\leq k\leq1),\\
 4 & D_k(4)=2\quad(0\leq k\leq3),\\
 5 & D_0(5)=2,\quad D_1(5)=3,\quad D_k(5)=4\quad(2\leq k\leq6).
\end{array}
\]
In each nontrivial lower-bound construction an original directed coefficient separates all generic conjugate branches.
body.proof_tex:
The admissible range is \(0\le k\le(n-1)(n-2)/2\).  For \(n=2\), only \(k=0\) is admissible, and \(\mathrm{lem:tree\mbox{-}maxima\mbox{-}support}\) gives
\[
 D_0(2)=1.
\]
For \(n=3\), one has \(k\in\{0,1\}\).  The two-block conclusion of \(\mathrm{lem:small\mbox{-}block\mbox{-}orientation\mbox{-}maxima}\) gives \(d_e(G)\le1\) for every finite query.  Budget monotonicity follows from \(\mathrm{def:graph\mbox{-}class}\): if \(j\le k\), then \(\mathcal G_{n,j}\subseteq\mathcal G_{n,k}\).  The tree witness \(D_0(3)=1\) supplies the reverse inequality for both budgets, so
\[
 D_k(3)=1\qquad(0\le k\le1).
\tag{97}
\]
For \(n=4\), the three-block bound gives \(D_k(4)\le2\) for every admissible \(0\le k\le3\).  The separating degree-two tree witness in \(\mathrm{lem:tree\mbox{-}maxima\mbox{-}support}\), together with budget monotonicity, gives the reverse inequality.  Hence
\[
 D_k(4)=2\qquad(0\le k\le3).
\tag{98}
\]
For \(n=5,k=0\), the tree lemma gives \(D_0(5)=2\).  If \(k=1\), the refined five-block calculation gives \(D_1(5)\le3\), while \(\mathrm{lem:five\mbox{-}node\mbox{-}cubic\mbox{-}coordinate\mbox{-}transfer}\) supplies a member of \(\mathcal G_{5,1}\) whose original edge has degree three.  Therefore
\[
 D_1(5)=3.
\tag{99}
\]
For admissible \(k\ge2\), the four-block bound gives \(D_k(5)\le4\).  The proved quartic witness belongs to \(\mathcal G_{5,2}\), and \(\mathcal G_{5,2}\subseteq\mathcal G_{5,k}\).  Consequently
\[
 D_k(5)=4\qquad(2\le k\le6).
\tag{100}
\]
These equations give the displayed table.  The tree, cubic, and quartic lower-bound constructions all query an original directed coefficient.  Their finite minimal polynomials are separable in characteristic zero, so the displayed degrees count distinct generic conjugate coordinate values, and those coefficients separate the branches.
body.justification: The exact table removes every vertex size through five from the unresolved frontier.
